notes: v21 enemy (Hollow region): Brute, a stubborn melee tank. A legless moss-furred ball (four paws are only PAINTED on the front), big curled ram horns at the front sides, a grumpy scowling face low on the front, a lilac wisp tuft on top and a lilac flower on the right horn. Mesh prepped with --no-ground-sheet (the flat base is real anatomy; the ground-sheet pass opened 118 floor boundary edges). Moves by a heavy hop with squash and stretch; Attack is a horn charge / headbutt. The horns are asymmetric in the mesh (left coil x -0.96..-0.37, right 0.13..0.86).
_placed_by: v21: placed by the writer from z/x mesh sections (zsec.py) and the calibrated views; checked with tools/lmcheck.py (blob mode). Body column at x=0,y=0 from the floor to z 1.22 (the y=0 section spans z 0..1.33; the wisp reaches 1.69). Face follower from inside the ball (y -0.2, z 0.32) to the face front (y -0.58, z 0.28; face section z 0.11..0.46). Horn bones run from where each coil leaves the skull top to its outermost loop (sections at y -0.3/-0.4 put each end at 0.47-0.56 of the coil's height). lmcheck: every point inside the mesh.
